resources.string: Please leave your phone on charger to avoid battery discharge.
Beginning sleep tracking: Screen will dim in 15 seconds…
Press back button to turn on screen. Do not press power button. Good night!
SleepBot will track your sleep, you can turn off your screen or doing other things, but try not to use any memory intensive applications.
No sensor data recorded for this entry.
Go to sleep soon to wake up on time!

If you don\'t go to sleep now, you can be reminded later in the following sleep cycles.\n\nThe times will be calculated to be 90 minutes apart starting with the next alarm time with 30 min subtracted for you to prepare and fall asleep.
You should really go to sleep or take a power nap now. It will boost your productivity!
